heading: A Salon Designed Around Your Dog
blockquote: Our open-plan Congresbury salon provides professional grooming for dogs of every breed, size and coat type.
body:
We believe great grooming begins with understanding the individual dog. Before we start, we consider your dog’s coat condition, grooming history, temperament and day-to-day lifestyle so we can recommend the most suitable approach.

Our team is always happy to explain what your dog’s coat needs and share practical advice to help you maintain it between appointments. From clipping and breed styling to puppy introductions, hand stripping and ultrasonic teeth cleaning, every service is delivered with your dog’s comfort and welfare at the centre of the experience.
